title: django-docutils unsafe rendering defaults expose worker files and raw HTML
summary: django-docutils renders lower-trust reStructuredText with unsafe Docutils defaults. Directives can disclose worker-readable files, make server-side requests and emit raw HTML or JavaScript.

severity.rationale: Attacker-controlled text can disclose local files and inject browser content. Developer preview and document-processing integrations must treat lower-trust RST as an input boundary.

exposure: Applications rendering lower-trust RST without safe overrides are exposed. Trusted static content is outside this condition.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 0.30.0 or later. Keep unsafe Docutils options disabled for lower-trust content; 0.30.0 also needs typing-extensions installed.
remediation.risk: Medium. Safe defaults disable features that trusted documents may use.

verification: Check the renderer version and confirm file insertion and raw directives remain disabled for lower-trust input.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record from directly inspected primary evidence; independent review pending.
